title: Avoiding Instant Application Rejections
description:
Getting instantly rejected for a job within minutes of submitted that two hour application kinda just makes you want to live off the grid amiright? But since I don’t to miss the next HBO mini series here’s a couple things to be aware of so that can stop happening. A “knockout question” is a hard yes/no requirement for a job. End up on the no side and that’s a reason for why the instant rejection can happen. Years of experience and education and tough to quickly address but you CAN address how you use job description keywords. Those keywords are skills the recruiter is looking for. MAKE SURE THEY END UP ON YOUR RESUME IF YOU HAVE EXPERIENCE. #application #applicationtips #jobapplication #jobapplications

transcript: getting rejected from a job the same minute you apply no way someone is looking at an application that fast likely what's going on is something called a knockout question this is a set of requirements that the company is very firm they need a yes on years of experience is probably the biggest one you'll see a degree as well and also if they ask if you have experience and specific skills obviously years of experience in education are kind of difficult to quickly go improve on but for the skills of a job if you have experience and what they're looking for make sure these words very directly end up on your resume and matching mode right within the teal resume Builder is a great way to grab those keywords you'll get the top five so you can guarantee the most important information makes it to your resume and with that you can eliminate reasons for those really annoying quick rejections
